resource "google_iam_workload_identity_pool_provider" "github" {
  project                            = "example-prod"
  workload_identity_pool_id          = "ci-pool"
  workload_identity_pool_provider_id = "github"

  attribute_mapping = {
    "google.subject"       = "assertion.sub"
    "attribute.repository" = "assertion.repository"
  }

  oidc {
    issuer_uri = "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
  }
}

resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "deployer" {
  service_account_id = "projects/example-prod/serviceAccounts/deployer@example-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  role               = "roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
  member             = "principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/123456789012/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/ci-pool/*"
}
